meaning: A small handheld gadget that stores music files and plays them through earbuds or headphones.
clues: A pocket-sized gadget that holds hundreds or even thousands of songs.
Songs are saved as files inside it, so there is no disc or tape.
You loaded the songs from your computer, then listened with earbuds.
The iPod was a very famous one.
It has two words. The first has two letters and a number, and the second is "player."
assumes: A CD player plays one shiny disc at a time
A cassette player plays music from tape
A record player plays large grooved discs

decoys.meaning: A machine that plays music from a shiny disc, usually one album at a time.
A machine that plays music from magnetic tape in a small plastic case.
A machine that plays music from a large grooved disc as it spins.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I held a few pages of writing. Those little gadgets held a whole music shelf!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a music app on your phone. Tip: keep the volume moderate to protect your hearing.
